_comment: Seed for the daily news watch dedup ledger. The daily run copies this to state.json on the aari/news-watch branch on first run, then maintains it there. Items listed here were already known at setup and are never reported as new.

nar_annual_report.note: NAR publishes year N's annual report in January of year N+1.

frec_meetings._comment: Calendar, not a feed. Each meeting reports at most three times: seen (new date appears), agenda (agenda/notice published), t7 (7 days out or closer). Stages already fired are listed per meeting date so a meeting sitting on the calendar for weeks never repeats.
frec_meetings.cadence: Monthly, generally the third Wednesday plus the Tuesday before it, two consecutive days from 8:30am ET, Orlando (Division of Real Estate Commission Chambers) with a Teams option.
